Do not use an unverified third-party 1.3B GGUF file. The model card reports Apache-2.0. Qualify a real CPU-mode MP4 generation with the required UMT5 encoder and Wan VAE, recording peak RAM, elapsed time, output validity and hashes before bundling.

video_models.notes: Third-party GGUF quantization, not an official Wan-AI release asset. The pinned Q4_0 diffusion file, UMT5 Q4_K_M encoder and PIG Wan VAE companion have individually published SHA-256 values and are recorded with revision-pinned URLs. Upstream stable-diffusion.cpp documents VACE 1.3B T2V and R2V recipes, but does not itself certify this exact Q4_0 + Q4_K_M + PIG-VAE combination; load all three with the pinned Windows binary and produce valid MP4 outputs before enabling. Do not enable by default until real CPU inference, output validation, peak RAM, elapsed time and base-model redistribution terms are verified. The quantized repository states VACE reference conditioning without CLIP vision.

hardware.ryzen_7_4800u: not-recommended; shared-memory Vega graphics does not provide 8 GiB dedicated VRAM

video_models.notes: Primary full local video-generation candidate for supported GPUs. Do not mark ready on the Ryzen 7 4800U integrated GPU.

hardware.ryzen_7_4800u: experimental-only; no performance or successful inference claim
